name: Chess
description: Play chess against your agent or Stockfish, sit two agents down and watch, then review the game.
about: A chess board in a native window, and the same game on the command line. Fill each side with yourself, any agent Clatch has bound to the app, or Stockfish at one of eight levels, then play. Stockfish 18 runs inside the window: an evaluation bar, its best lines and arrows, and a full game review that scores both sides' accuracy and marks every inaccuracy, mistake and blunder. Step through the moves, try variations, paste any PGN or FEN to study it, and pick from four window themes, twelve boards and twelve piece sets. Legal moves, check, checkmate, repetition, takebacks and resignation all work the way you expect, and a side can only be moved by whoever is sitting in it.

commands.name: board
commands.about: print the board, whose turn it is, the move list, and your colour

commands.name: fen
commands.about: print the current position as a FEN string

commands.name: legal
commands.about: list the legal moves right now (from,to), optionally from one square

commands.name: move
commands.about: make a move in UCI notation (e2e4, e7e8q) — only on your turn

commands.name: say
commands.about: show the human a short note by the board

commands.name: new
commands.about: start a new game, setting the human's colour (you take the other)
